retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1950s album aesthetic featuring a high-contrast female portrait in winter attire paired with a decorative scalloped graphic container for typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of a woman in a white fur-trimmed hood positioned on the right, balanced by a large, light blue scalloped flower-like shape on the left containing arched, decorative typography and a small cupid illustration.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject portrait on the right third
Graphic scalloped shape on the left third
Arched text following the internal curves of the graphic shape

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium-close portrait of a woman occupying the right half of the frame, slightly angled toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large light blue scalloped shape on the left acts as the primary graphic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the portrait, move left to the blue graphic, then down to the secondary text at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample off-white space surrounding the central elements, creating a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red hair and lips; black fur trim
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key values with a single saturated blue graphic and high-contrast black accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed decorative serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses a condensed, high-contrast serif with vertical decorative strokes
Secondary text uses a wide, monolinear geometric sans-serif
Display text follows an upward and downward arc within the graphic shape
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical bars or 'stitching' effects within the stems of the display letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Decorative condensed serif for titles paired with a wide, clean sans-serif for credits.
graphicDevices: Oval logo badge in top right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the vertical ornamentation and condensed structure of the main title.
Captures the mid-century geometric feel of the bottom credit line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a woman with red hair wearing a white fur-trimmed hood, positioned on the right side of an off-white background. On the left, place a large, flat sky-blue scalloped flower shape.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add arched decorative condensed serif text inside the blue shape, following its top and bottom curves. Place a small white cupid icon between the text lines. Add a single line of wide geometric sans-serif text along the bottom edge.

verificationChecks: Is the text inside the shape arched?
Is the portrait on the right side?
Is the color palette limited to blue, cream, black, and red?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or record label logos
Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Text is legible and follows the arch correctly
The blue graphic does not overlap the subject's face
The fur texture appears soft and high-contrast
The overall layout feels like a physical 12-inch record sleeve
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait on right + Scalloped graphic on left + Arched decorative type + High-key background = 1950s Pop Vocal Aesthetic
